title: Explanation
description: The XAI (Explainable AI) output. Generated by AI-4 (Explanation Agent). Powers the UI's Agent Reasoning Trace and Citation Chips.

case_id.description: Reference to the case being explained.

explanation_text.description: 3-5 sentence plain-English explanation citing pattern + anomaly + risk score. Rendered in serif font in the UI.

type.description: What kind of evidence this citation references.

citations.description: Every claim in explanation_text must have at least one citation. Rendered as clickable chips in the UI. No citation = no trust.

confidence.description: Agent's confidence in the explanation (0.0 = low, 1.0 = high). Below 0.60 triggers 'Human review required' banner in UI.
